# porch_tenant (Resource)

A Porch tenant (for example a family or a team). Deleting a tenant deletes everything it owns. Requires an installation `admin` token.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "porch_tenant" "smiths" {
  slug = "smiths"
  name = "The Smiths"

  # Optional per-tenant session limits (0 = installation default).
  session_idle_seconds     = 7200
  session_absolute_seconds = 604800
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name.
- `slug` (String) URL-safe identifier, unique in the installation. Changing it forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `session_absolute_seconds` (Number) Per-tenant absolute session lifetime in seconds (60..7776000); `0` (default) uses the installation default.
- `session_idle_seconds` (Number) Per-tenant session idle timeout in seconds (60..7776000); `0` (default) uses the installation default.
- `status` (String) `active` (default) or `disabled`. Disabling a tenant blocks sign-ins to it.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Tenant ID (`ten_…`).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import porch_tenant.smiths smiths   # tenant ID or slug
```
